recipes.steps: 1. Blend a thin batter. | 2. Heat butter in a hot pan, pour in, bake until dramatically puffed. | 3. Dust with sugar and lemon.
recipes.notes: Puffs in the oven; serve at once.

recipes.title: Lamb and pine-nut kibbeh
recipes.ingredients: 16 oz lamb; 2 cup bulgur; 0.5 cup pine nuts; 2 each onion; 1 tsp cinnamon
recipes.steps: 1. Soak bulgur, blend half with lamb and onion into a paste for the shell. | 2. Brown the rest of the lamb with pine nuts and cinnamon for the filling. | 3. Form shells around the filling, then bake or fry until deep golden.
recipes.notes: Pine nuts are a tree-nut allergen; bulgur is wheat.

recipes.title: Stuffed grape leaves (warak enab) with lamb
recipes.ingredients: 12 oz lamb; 1.5 cup white rice; 3 each lemon; 1 cup parsley; 2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.steps: 1. Mix lamb, rice and herbs. | 2. Roll tightly in grape leaves. | 3. Layer in a pot, weight, and simmer slowly with lemon and oil.

recipes.title: Maqluba (upside-down rice with chicken and eggplant)
recipes.ingredients: 8 piece chicken thigh; 3 cup white rice; 2 each eggplant l; 0.25 cup pine nuts; 3 tbsp olive oil
recipes.steps: 1. Fry eggplant, brown chicken. | 2. Layer chicken, eggplant and spiced rice in a pot. | 3. Cook until the rice is done, then invert onto a platter and scatter pine nuts.

recipes.title: Mujaddara (lentils and rice with crisp onion)
recipes.ingredients: 2 cup lentils; 1.5 cup white rice; 4 each onion; 4 tbsp olive oil; 1 tsp cumin
recipes.steps: 1. Cook lentils until nearly tender, add rice and spice. | 2. Caramelize a large quantity of onion slowly until dark and sweet. | 3. Fold half the onion through, top with the rest.

recipes.title: Shish barak (dumplings in yogurt sauce)
recipes.ingredients: 10 oz lamb; 3 cup flour; 3 cup yogurt greek full; 0.25 cup pine nuts; 4 clove garlic
recipes.steps: 1. Make a dough and a spiced lamb filling, form small dumplings. | 2. Bake the dumplings until golden. | 3. Simmer in a stabilized garlic-yogurt sauce until tender.

recipes.title: Fattet hummus (layered chickpea and yogurt)
recipes.ingredients: 3 cup chickpeas; 2 cup yogurt greek full; 2 each flatbread; 3 tbsp tahini l; 0.25 cup pine nuts
recipes.steps: 1. Crisp torn flatbread. | 2. Warm chickpeas, layer over the bread. | 3. Cover with a tahini-yogurt sauce and toasted pine nuts.
recipes.notes: Meatless; tahini flags sesame, flatbread wheat.

recipes.title: Sayadieh-style spiced rice and caramelized onion
recipes.ingredients: 3 cup white rice; 4 each onion; 3 tbsp olive oil; 1 tsp cumin; 0.25 cup pine nuts
recipes.steps: 1. Deeply caramelize onion, reserving some for the top. | 2. Toast spices, add rice and stock from the onion, cook through. | 3. Finish with pine nuts.
recipes.notes: Traditionally served with fish; here as the meatless rice base.

recipes.title: Pierogi ruskie (potato and twarog dumplings)
recipes.ingredients: 3 cup flour; 1 each egg; 2 each potato p; 1 cup twarog; 2 tbsp butter
recipes.steps: 1. Make a dough, rest it. | 2. Boil and mash potato, fold in twarog and softened onion. | 3. Fill and seal dumplings, boil until they float, finish in butter.

recipes.title: Bigos (hunter's stew)
recipes.ingredients: 16 oz pork shoulder; 12 oz kielbasa; 4 cup sauerkraut; 4 cup cabbage; 1 oz dried mushroom
recipes.steps: 1. Brown the meats. | 2. Combine with sauerkraut, cabbage and soaked mushrooms. | 3. Simmer very slowly for hours; better the next day.

recipes.title: Golabki (stuffed cabbage rolls)
recipes.ingredients: 12 oz ground beef 90; 6 oz pork shoulder; 1.5 cup white rice; 1 each cabbage; 2 cup tomato crushed
recipes.steps: 1. Blanch cabbage leaves. | 2. Fill with a beef-pork-rice mix, roll tightly. | 3. Bake in tomato sauce until tender.

recipes.title: Pierogi z miesem (meat dumplings)
recipes.ingredients: 3 cup flour; 1 each egg; 10 oz pork shoulder; 1 each onion; 2 tbsp butter
recipes.steps: 1. Make dough. | 2. Grind cooked seasoned pork with onion for the filling. | 3. Fill, seal, boil, then finish in butter.

recipes.title: Kotlet schabowy (breaded pork cutlet)
recipes.ingredients: 24 oz pork chop; 2 each egg; 1.5 cup breadcrumbs; 0.5 cup flour; 3 tbsp butter
recipes.steps: 1. Pound the pork thin. | 2. Dredge in flour, egg, then breadcrumbs. | 3. Fry in butter until deep golden, served with potatoes.

recipes.title: Barszcz (beetroot soup) with mushroom uszka
recipes.ingredients: 6 each beet; 1 oz dried mushroom; 2 cup flour; 1 each egg; 1 each onion
recipes.steps: 1. Simmer a clear beet broth. | 2. Make tiny mushroom-filled uszka dumplings. | 3. Serve the broth with the dumplings floated in.

recipes.title: Placki ziemniaczane (potato pancakes)
recipes.ingredients: 6 each potato p; 2 each egg; 0.5 cup flour; 1 each onion; 4 tbsp olive oil
recipes.steps: 1. Grate potato and onion, drain well. | 2. Bind with egg and flour. | 3. Fry spoonfuls until crisp and golden on both sides.

recipes.title: Ribollita (Tuscan bread and bean soup)
recipes.ingredients: 3 cup cannellini i; 4 cup kale; 4 slice bread white; 2 cup tomato crushed; 3 tbsp olive oil
recipes.steps: 1. Simmer beans and vegetables into a thick soup. | 2. Stir in torn day-old bread to thicken. | 3. Rest, then reheat; finish with oil.

recipes.title: Pasta e fagioli
recipes.ingredients: 3 cup borlotti; 2 cup pasta; 1 cup tomato crushed; 1 each onion; 2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.steps: 1. Soften aromatics, add beans and tomato. | 2. Partially mash for body. | 3. Cook the pasta in the soup until tender.

recipes.title: Farro and chestnut soup
recipes.ingredients: 2 cup farro; 1.5 cup chestnut; 1 cup cannellini i; 1 each onion; 2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.steps: 1. Toast farro. | 2. Simmer with chestnuts and beans until creamy. | 3. Finish with oil and pepper.

recipes.title: Polenta with sage and pecorino
recipes.ingredients: 2 cup polenta; 1 cup pecorino; 3 tbsp butter; 2 tbsp sage
recipes.steps: 1. Cook polenta slowly until smooth. | 2. Fry sage in butter. | 3. Beat pecorino into the polenta, top with the sage butter.

recipes.title: Minestrone alla monastica
recipes.ingredients: 2 cup cannellini i; 1 cup borlotti; 1 cup farro; 2 cup tomato crushed; 3 cup kale
recipes.steps: 1. Build a vegetable and bean base. | 2. Add farro and greens. | 3. Simmer until everything is tender and the broth thickens.
recipes.notes: Farro is a wheat species; carries wheat allergen.

recipes.title: Lasagna alla Benedettina (cheese and vegetable)
recipes.ingredients: 12 sheet pasta; 2 cup ricotta; 2 cup mozzarella; 4 cup spinach; 2 cup bechamel
recipes.steps: 1. Make a bechamel. | 2. Layer pasta with ricotta, spinach, bechamel and mozzarella. | 3. Bake until set and golden.

recipes.title: Quiche Lorraine
recipes.ingredients: 5 each egg; 1 cup cream; 1.5 cup gruyere; 4 oz bacon; 1 crust puff pastry
recipes.steps: 1. Line a tin with pastry. | 2. Whisk eggs and cream with gruyere and browned lardons. | 3. Pour into the shell and bake until just set.

recipes.title: Gratin dauphinois
recipes.ingredients: 8 each potato p; 2 cup cream; 1 cup gruyere; 2 tbsp butter; 2 clove garlic
recipes.steps: 1. Slice potato thin. | 2. Layer in a garlic-rubbed dish with cream. | 3. Top with gruyere and bake slowly until tender and bronzed.

recipes.title: Coq au vin
recipes.ingredients: 10 piece chicken thigh; 1.5 cup wine white; 3 cup mushroom; 3 oz bacon; 2 each onion
recipes.steps: 1. Brown chicken and lardons. | 2. Add wine, mushrooms and onion. | 3. Braise low and slow until the sauce is rich.
recipes.notes: Named wine and bacon: alcohol + meat tags.

recipes.title: Lentilles du Puy with leek (lentil ragout)
recipes.ingredients: 2 cup lentils du puy; 2 each leek; 2 each carrot; 1 tbsp dijon; 2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.steps: 1. Sweat leek and carrot. | 2. Add lentils and stock, simmer until tender. | 3. Finish with a spoon of dijon and oil.

recipes.title: Croque monsieur (baked)
recipes.ingredients: 8 slice bread white; 1.5 cup gruyere; 8 oz ham deli; 1.5 cup bechamel; 2 tbsp butter
recipes.steps: 1. Build ham-and-gruyere sandwiches. | 2. Top with bechamel and more cheese. | 3. Bake until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Soupe a l'oignon gratinee (French onion soup)
recipes.ingredients: 6 each onion; 4 slice bread white; 1.5 cup gruyere; 3 tbsp butter; 6 cup veg stock
recipes.steps: 1. Caramelize onion deeply in butter. | 2. Add stock and simmer. | 3. Top with bread and gruyere, broil until molten.
recipes.notes: Use vegetable stock to keep meatless.

recipes.title: Lentils with cumin and warm flatbread

recipes.steps: 1. Simmer lentils with cumin until soft and savory. | 2. Warm the flatbread and serve alongside with a little oil.

recipes.title: Fava beans with olive oil and lemon (ful)
